elements.html:
Teaching {module} Self-paced Online Professional Learning

Post-Module Survey

Code.org relies on surveys as a crucial tool to stay connected to teachers, gather feedback about our curriculum and your teaching experience, and to improve our programs.

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share anonymous, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your anonymized responses will be used by Code.org for program improvement.

Your honesty and candor are appreciated.

Teaching {module}: Post-Module Survey

elements.name: section1_goals
elements.html: The questions in this section aim to understand your experience with the Teaching {module} self-paced professional learning module.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_thinking_critically_about_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in critically evaluating AI outputs and recognizing the human decisions behind them.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_ai_and_machine_learning
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in understanding AI and machine learning, including how to train models.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_programming_with_music_lab
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in their understanding of relevant musical terminology, and in exploring programming concepts through music.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_interactive_animations_and_games
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in how to use Game Lab, and in their understanding of loops and conditionals in game design.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_the_design_process
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in their understanding of the design process, and in building prototypes in App Lab.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_data_and_society
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in understanding and applying foundational data concepts.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_creating_apps_with_devices_microbit
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in building apps with physical devices and understanding the CS concepts behind them.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_creating_apps_with_devices_circuit
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in building apps with physical devices and understanding the CS concepts behind them.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_aid_preparing_to_teach_web_development
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in their understanding of key web development concepts in the unit, and in their understanding of how to use Web Lab
